_about: Cut block: cut3 (output frames 0-36 side, 37-76 wrist, 77-112 cctv; hard cuts at 2.31 s and 4.81 s). One clock: each shot shows the world at the same times as its camera's separate video.
temporal_caption: From 0:00 to 0:02 a static side view of the table: the white robot arm carries the light-blue pitcher over the clear glass and starts to tilt it. At 0:02 a hard cut to the robot's wrist camera looking along the gripper: the pitcher's rim at the bottom of the frame and a thin stream of water running down into the glass, which fills. At 0:05 a hard cut to a high security-camera view from a corner of the room: the robot tilts the pitcher back upright and moves it away from the glass.

aesthetics.composition: Three framings of the same pour: side, egocentric, high corner

cinematography.camera_motion: Three shots joined by hard cuts: a fixed side camera, a moving wrist camera, a fixed ceiling camera
cinematography.camera_angle: Table height from the side, then down from the robot's wrist, then high angle
cinematography.focus: The pitcher, stream and glass in focus

style_medium: Real-world footage edited from three cameras: side camera, robot wrist camera and CCTV; photoreal live-action
artistic_style: Realistic multi-camera edit of one robot pour

segments.description: Side view: the arm brings the pitcher over the glass and starts tilting
Wrist view: water pours from the lip into the glass
CCTV view: the pitcher is tilted back and moved away

transitions: Hard cut at 0:02 from the side view to the wrist camera
Hard cut at 0:05 from the wrist camera to the CCTV view
